rules.port_coordinate_scope: PI/PO node XY may move; identities remain fixed.
rules.objective: Reduce actual routed bounding area and exported QCA cells; both non-increasing, one strictly improved. Distinguish node-box proxy from actual routed area.
rules.routing_execution: One executor-derived complete order after moves; no portfolio fallback.
rules.search_contract: Return a direct gate proposal with routing_order=null; the compiler derives and logs one order using exactly the same rule as the deterministic control. All area/device, exploration, graph identity, clock and physical constraints remain enforced.
rules.proposal_contract: Model synthesizes internal gate coordinates; routing_order=null; executor derives the disclosed deterministic order after placement.
rules.geometry_guidance: Inspect the shared gate-geometry hints as possible starting moves. You may combine or adapt them, or propose new coordinates. Do not repeat a failed geometry merely by swapping the edge list. Use a smaller displacement or a different node subset when routing fails. If moving ports is permitted and they set the outer box, coordinate their relocation with internal gates. Swapping unrelated distant nodes often creates detours; give it a concrete geometric justification.

proposal.rationale: Target dense y=22–25 band where multiple edges (e.g., [9,13], [11,13], [7,14]) incur detours due to vertical congestion. Move nodes 13,14 down to y=24 to align with neighbor anchors and reduce vertical routing span; shift 16,18 to y=27 to compress top layer and free y=28–31 for cleaner fanout to POs. Lower layer nodes 7,8 moved to y=21 to close gap near inputs and enable shorter paths from PI0–PI3. Swap 9↔11 to balance x-positions: 9 (now at 29,22) better serves 13’s x=28, while 11 (now at 28,22) reduces crosstalk with 9’s former path and improves symmetry with 7/8. All moves stay within vacancy hotspots (e.g., window_25_31_25_31, window_18_27_18_28) and preserve no collisions. This coordinated contraction targets area reduction via y-height compression (current height=12 → projected 11) while maintaining fanin order and minimizing Manhattan edge growth.

Compress vertical span by shifting layer-2 nodes (7,8) down to y=21 to align with input row (y=20) and reduce fanin detours; move layer-3 nodes (13,14) to y=23 to eliminate congestion at y=25 where edges [9,13], [11,13], [7,14] previously incurred detours; shift layer-4 nodes (16,18) to y=26 to close gap before POs and avoid y=28–31 overuse. All moves target verified vacancy hotspots (e.g., window_25_31_25_31, window_18_27_18_28), preserve no collisions, and keep x-coordinates within low-congestion bands. This coordinated 6-move contraction reduces bounding height from 12→11 tiles while maintaining fanin order and minimizing Manhattan edge growth—critical for certified area/QCA reduction.
